camel_example: aliyun devops POST /api/v4/projects/check_runs/update_check_run --region cn-hangzhou --organizationId 60de7a6852743a5162b5f957 --checkRunId 2 --accessToken f0b1e61db5961df5975a93f9129d2513 --repositoryIdentity '2835387_或_codeup/codeup-demo' --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"conclusion":"success","output":{"summary":"摘要信息内容","images":[{"imageUrl":"xxx","alt":"test-image-alt","caption":"test"}],"text":"详情信息内容","title":"Mighty_Readme_report"},"completedAt":"2023-03-15T08:00:00Z","detailsUrl":"xx","name":"my-check-ci","startedAt":"2023-03-15T08:00:00Z","externalId":"42","annotations":[{"endLine":2,"path":"demo/test.txt","endColumn":5,"rawDetails":"详情信息内容","startColumn":3,"startLine":1,"annotationLevel":"failure","message":"回写检查注释的简要描述信息","title":"检查注释的标题"}],"status":"completed"}
description_en: Only the writer of a check run can update it
description_zh: 更新check run记录信息，须当前身份与check run的写入人身份一致，才能进行更新
name: UpdateCheckRun

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. You can obtain it from the URL of your Alibaba Cloud DevOps organization page, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is optional when authenticating with an AccessKey or STS temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the check run
parameters.name: check_run_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the check run
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The time when the check run started.

> The time must be in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. For example, `2023-03-15T08:00:00Z`
parameters.help_zh:
检查运行的开始时间



> ISO 8601 格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ，如 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.name: started_at

parameters.help_en:
The time when the check run completed.

> The time must be in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. For example, `2023-03-15T08:00:00Z`
parameters.help_zh:
检查运行的完结时间


> 说明 ISO 8601 格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ，如 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.name: completed_at

parameters.help_en:
The ID from an external system.

> This ID comes from your external check system. You can specify any string as the ID, and the platform stores it as a string
parameters.help_zh:
外部系统的ID
> 外部系统，指用户的检测系统；该字段由用户自行决定写入何种ID，平台仅使用字符串类型进行存储
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of a page with more details about the check run. The platform will link to this URL
parameters.help_zh: 三方交互系统的详情地址，由用户自行决定，平台仅提供跳转能力
parameters.name: details_url

parameters.help_en:
The current status of the check run. Valid values:

- `queued`: The check run is queued.

- `in_progress`: The check run is in progress.

- `completed`: The check run is completed
parameters.help_zh:
状态
- queued：队列中
- in_progress：运行中
- completed：已完结
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The final conclusion of the check run. This parameter is required if `status` is set to `completed`. Valid values:

- `cancelled`: The check run was canceled.

- `failure`: The check run failed.

- `neutral`: The check run is neutral. This is treated as a success.

- `success`: The check run succeeded.

- `skipped`: The check run was skipped. This is treated as a success.

- `timed_out`: The check run timed out
parameters.help_zh:
结论

- cancelled：已取消
- failure：失败
- neutral：中立状态，算作成功状态
- success：成功
- skipped：跳过，算作成功状态
- timed_out：超时
parameters.name: conclusion

fields.help_en: The title of the UI module. This is different from the `name` parameter
fields.name: title

fields.help_en:
A short summary of the check run.

> This field supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB)
fields.help_zh:
检查运行的摘要信息


> 支持markdown格式；最大字符长度为64KB，即65535个字符
fields.name: summary

fields.help_en:
The detailed information about the check run.

> This field supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB)
fields.help_zh:
详情信息


> 支持markdown格式；最大字符长度为64KB，即65535个字符
fields.name: text

element_fields.help_en: The alternative text for the image
element_fields.name: alt

element_fields.help_en: The URL of the image. The URL must be publicly accessible, or the image will not be displayed
element_fields.help_zh: 图片地址，须确保能够有效访问，否则页面无法展示
element_fields.name: image_url

element_fields.help_en: A short description of the image
element_fields.name: caption

fields.help_en:
A list of image objects to display in the output.

> A check run can display images in the output module
fields.help_zh:
图片信息列表

> check run支持在output的展示模块中，展示图片信息
fields.name: images

parameters.help_en: Contains output to display on the check run page
parameters.name: output

element_fields.help_en: The path of the file to which the annotation applies
element_fields.name: path

element_fields.help_en:
The start line of the annotation.

> Line numbering starts at 1. Ensure the line number is valid for the specified file; otherwise, the annotation will not be displayed
element_fields.help_zh:
起始行


> 从1开始；需要用户自行确保文件行数的有效性，否则无法展示
element_fields.name: start_line

element_fields.help_en: The end line of the annotation
element_fields.name: end_line

element_fields.help_en:
The start column of the annotation.

> This parameter is valid only when `startLine` is the same as `endLine`
element_fields.help_zh:
起始列


> 当且仅当startLine=endLine时，该字段值有效
element_fields.name: start_column

element_fields.help_en:
The end column of the annotation.

> This parameter is valid only when `startLine` is the same as `endLine`
element_fields.help_zh:
结束列


> 当且仅当startLine=endLine时，该字段值有效
element_fields.name: end_column

element_fields.help_en:
The level of the annotation. Valid values:

- `notice`: A minor issue.

- `warning`: Warning.

- `failure`: A severe issue
element_fields.help_zh:
检查注释的等级

- notice：轻微
- warning：警告
- failure：严重
element_fields.name: annotation_level

element_fields.example: 回写检查注释的简要描述信息
element_fields.help_en: A short description of the annotation
element_fields.name: message

element_fields.help_en: Detailed information about the annotation, limited to 64 KB in size
element_fields.help_zh: 详情信息，限制64KB以内的大小
element_fields.name: raw_details

parameters.help_en:
A list of annotations.

> - You can display code quality results from third-party systems as annotations on the check run.
>
> - This field is append-only during updates. To avoid duplicates, do not resubmit existing annotations
parameters.help_zh:
检查注释列表


> - 对于某些三方系统，可能会获得代码质量检测结果，若希望进行展示，可通过API将信息通过annotation写入到check run中
> - 在更新操作中，annotations信息只会新增，所以在使用时，尽量不要重复写入
parameters.name: annotations
